= Source code whitespace
:source-highlighter: rouge
:tabsize: 3

== Listing whitespace

----
  leading spaces
repeated    spaces
a	value

after blank

----

== Literal whitespace

....
  leading literal
literal    spaces

after literal blank

....

== Source whitespace and block tab size

[source,rust,tabsize=6]
----
  let value    = 5;
a	value

println!("after blank");

----

== Styled paragraphs

[source,rust]
  source indentation    stays

[listing]
  listing indentation    stays

[literal]
  literal indentation    stays

== Long lines

----
space-separated content that is deliberately long enough to cross the usable width of an A4 page and confirm that the PDF wraps at spaces without clipping any words from the source line
unbroken_ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789
----

[source,rust]
----
fn highlighted_line_with_no_breaks() { let token = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789"; }
----
